Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson passed away in his sleep last night at 11pm November 27th 2028. The former president of Iceland was perhaps most well known for fending off a polar bear on Jan Mayen with nothing but a branch, an act immortalised by its presence on all Icelandic military uniforms. During his 26 year reign as president, he was seen by many as a fine leader. He fixed the economy almost immediately after the 2008 financial crisis, played a part in de-escalating the Russian invasion of Ukraine and was a strong advocate for the legalisation of prostitution.

Without Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson, the SENT program, important energy deals with the UK and important increases to Iceland's defence budget may never have been made. He will be greatly missed.

Newly elected president Árni Páll Árnason has declared that Reykjavik city hall will be renamed as "Grimsson Hall" in his memory.
